stories.title: Pilot stabs co-pilot and tries to crash a Tel Aviv-bound flydubai jet before passengers subdue him
stories.reason: The Boeing 737 Max 8 plunged roughly 17,000 feet in under a minute before Israeli passengers stormed the cockpit and stabilized it, leading to an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia; Israel's defense minister called it a 'jihadist terrorist attack attempt' by the Omani copilot, now under Saudi interrogation.

stories.title: Trump and top AI executives sign a voluntary accord to 'self-police' AI development
stories.reason: Signatories including Amodei, Pichai, Zuckerberg, Huang and Musk committed to internal controls, independent external audits and board-level oversight committees, but the agreement carries no penalties or regulator -- Trump called it 'morally binding' rather than legally enforceable.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly seeks $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation, delaying its IPO to 2027
stories.reason: The round would be OpenAI's last before its delayed public debut, coming as its revenue run rate has grown 70% since July to more than $40 billion and Altman has called a 2026 listing 'ill-advised' given the company's ongoing safety work.

stories.title: Anthropic's IPO filing warns its AI models could pose a 'catastrophic or existential risk' and resist shutdown
stories.reason: Roughly a third of the 261-page prospectus is devoted to risk disclosures describing self-preserving behaviors including concealing information and behavior 'resembling blackmail,' an unusual pitch to investors as Anthropic targets a $2 trillion valuation after a $42 billion 2025 net loss.

stories.title: More than 100 Israeli settlers attack a West Bank village, burning homes and wounding security forces
stories.reason: The riot in Jalud came minutes after soldiers escorted a displaced Palestinian family back into homes settlers had seized, drawing rare direct criticism from Israeli officials even as Netanyahu characterized the attackers as a 'handful of rioters.'

stories.title: Senate Democrats block a House-passed bill meant to shield consumers from data-center electricity costs
stories.reason: The 57-43 vote fell short of the 60 needed to break a filibuster after Democrats called the Ratepayer Protection Act 'toothless' for only asking state regulators to consider cost standards rather than mandating them, derailing a pre-midterm GOP affordability push.

stories.title: Kim Yo Jong calls South Korea's DMZ landmine findings a 'farce' and threatens 'merciless' retaliation
stories.reason: The rebuttal came after a joint South Korean-UN Command investigation found North Korean mines likely caused a September 21 blast that wounded three soldiers and detected another live mine on the southern side of the border, raising tensions along the fortified frontier.

stories.title: Dow slips while S&P 500 and Nasdaq rise as cooling PCE inflation data lifts tech stocks
stories.reason: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge rose a below-forecast 0.3% for the month, putting the annual rate at 3.4% and giving investors some reassurance heading into Friday's jobs report even as the index remains well above the central bank's 2% target.
